notes: Advisories affecting PromptHalo, plus relevant third-party advisories and external guidance we have assessed. The coordinated disclosure record lives in disclosure-record.json. Edit this file in the repository and commit; the Trust Center reads it on the next page load. Plain text only, it is escaped on render. url must be http(s) or it is dropped, and it opens in a new tab. order must be First-order, Second-order, Third-order or Ecosystem; any other value renders no badge. impact renders green when it begins with 'No'. Every entry is a published claim, so state customer impact only where you can evidence it. Records may also carry affected, fixedIn, patched, cvss and remediation, plus a fields array of {label, value} pairs for anything else.

orderMeaning.First-order: The issue is in PromptHalo's own code, service or configuration.
orderMeaning.Second-order: The issue is in a component, library or vendor PromptHalo uses directly.
orderMeaning.Third-order: The issue reaches PromptHalo through one of our vendors' own suppliers.
orderMeaning.Ecosystem: No dependency path to PromptHalo. Listed because customers ask about it.

advisories.title: Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services
advisories.why: Listed because it applies directly to what PromptHalo builds. This is guidance addressed to developers, vendors and operators of agentic AI, not a defect in a product or a vendor. No dependency path is involved, so there is no second or third-order exposure to assess.
advisories.detail: Joint guidance published by CISA, the NSA and the cyber agencies of Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United Kingdom, covering privilege escalation, design and configuration flaws, behavioral misalignment, cascading failures and accountability in agentic AI. PromptHalo reviewed the guidance against its own agent controls. Per-agent identity, scoped tool permissions and full logging of agent actions were already in place, so no product change was required. This is guidance rather than a vulnerability in PromptHalo, and no customer action is needed.
